title: General Session 1
summary: Structured General workout focusing on speed, endurance, strength, economy.
riskReason: Varied workouts across distances develop all-around fitness and prevent monotony. Monitor fatigue and maintain proper technique.
intensityGuide: Use relative intensities such as easy effort, threshold effort, race effort, or controlled hard based on category goals.
variants: Easier: Reduce number of reps or increase rest between intervals.
Harder: Add one extra rep or slightly increase distance for main sets.
coachingNotes: Varied workouts across distances develop all-around fitness and prevent monotony.
commonMistakes: Common mistakes include running too hard on easy portions, neglecting recovery, or poor pacing.
safetyNotes: Begin with a thorough dynamic warm-up and avoid pushing through pain. Stay hydrated and stop if you feel dizzy.
